2018 Q4.bq: We delivered strong fourth quarter results with revenues and profitability above our expectations, marking a great finish to a strong year for Lantheus.

2019 Q2.gq: Turning now to our third quarter guidance and updated full year financial expectations, we expect the third-quarter revenue to be in a range of $83 million to $85 million.

2019 Q3.gq: Revenue guidance for Q4 is therefore a range of $89 million to $91 million.

2020 Q1.bq: While revenue came in at the top end of guidance for the full quarter, we saw a meaningful drop off beginning during the last two weeks March.

2021 Q2.gq: Taken together, adjusted EPS should be in the range of $0.05 to $0.07 for the third quarter.

2021 Q3.gq: Turning now to guidance for Q4 and the full year; we forecast revenue to be in a range of $110 million to $115 million for the fourth quarter of 2021, an increase of approximately 17% and 22% over the fourth quarter of 2020.
